P1_identity_before_trust.title: Identity Before Trust
P1_identity_before_trust.statement: No item, entity, or record shall be trusted as uniquely identified by QID alone. All identity resolution must use the compound-key model: QID + CorrectChoice + ExplanationWrong_Pattern + Template_Family + File_Path. Identity is verified before any certification, remediation, or delivery decision.

historical_evidence.DL-029: 257 Pack B false-positive DL-008 flags caused by forward-scan methodology that trusted QID-first-match identity. Resolved by compound-key identity model.
historical_evidence.S320_failure: Wrong variants targeted during remediation because QID-only resolution matched the first object in the file, not the canonical seed.
historical_evidence.DL-036: 40-item routing divergence between tools using different QID regex patterns — the correct tool used compound identity awareness.
historical_evidence.Pack_B_CC_before_QID: Pack B stores CorrectChoice before QuestionID in JSON object structure — a format anomaly that QID-trusting scanners cannot handle.

operational_validation.governance_guard_rule2: Object-boundary extraction (v2) validates identity at the object level, not the QID level
operational_validation.cross_engine_consistency: S254: 95/100 — 7 registries validated, 1 anomaly identified and tracked

P1_identity_before_trust.violation_detection: Any tool, scan, or process that uses QID alone as a unique identifier without cross-referencing at least two compound-key fields. Detected via: DL-029-class false-positive audit (object-boundary vs. window-scan count divergence > 0).
P1_identity_before_trust.enforcement: governance-guard.js Rule 2 (object-boundary extraction) — prevents identity-blind writes

P2_scan_once_consume_many.title: Scan Once, Consume Many
P2_scan_once_consume_many.statement: Every scan, validation, or analysis of raw content files shall produce a re-consumable artifact. Downstream consumers (readiness scorer, certification engine, delivery mechanism) shall consume artifacts, never re-scan raw files independently. One scan → one artifact → many consumers.

historical_evidence.DL-008_scan_redundancy: 22 DL-008 scan events performed across 15 sessions — each independently re-scanning raw files with no artifact reuse.
historical_evidence.DL-026_scan_redundancy: 18 DL-026 scan events — each with divergent methodology producing conflicting counts (632 vs 1,005 vs 1,056).
historical_evidence.DL-036_pipeline_divergence: 40-item BLOCKED routing divergence because Candidate Engine independently re-scanned Pack E with a stale regex, instead of consuming the Readiness Scorer artifact.
historical_evidence.S809_chain_cost: 4 sessions, 60 agent-spawns, 47 report files, 0 pack-file writes. 6.2:1 duplication ratio. All preventable with artifact consumption.

operational_validation.scan_orchestrator: S202 scan architecture design — one scan orchestrator produces artifact consumed by downstream stages
operational_validation.artifact_reuse_gap: S813 C2 — pipeline artifact reuse identified as blocking condition for full Framework v2 adoption
operational_validation.readiness_scorer: S322 produces readiness_scoring.json consumed by certification pipeline

P2_scan_once_consume_many.violation_detection: Two or more tools produce divergent results for the same metric from the same source file. Detected via: cross-tool BLOCKED count comparison (candidate_count_a != candidate_count_b).
P2_scan_once_consume_many.enforcement: S813 C2 (pipeline artifact reuse) — blocking condition for full adoption. New tools must register as artifact consumers.

P3_delta_review.title: Delta Review
P3_delta_review.statement: Only items that have changed since the last certification wave shall be reviewed. SHA-256 content hashing identifies unchanged items (typically 80%). Full re-review of entire packs is waste. Review effort shall scale with change volume, not pack size.

historical_evidence.S809_unchanged_items: 38 seeds, 4 sessions, 60 agent-spawns — 80% of items unchanged from prior wave yet all were re-reviewed from scratch.
historical_evidence.S200_agent_I: 80% unchanged per wave — systematic waste confirmed by 10-agent discovery session.
historical_evidence.DR-002: 3-4 duplicate ExplanationCorrect analyses per session on identical content.
historical_evidence.agent_redundancy: 4-7 agents re-audit same ExplanationWrong fields per session, reaching identical conclusions 95%+ of the time.

operational_validation.delta_ledger: S206 operational baseline — delta ledger tracks SHA-256 hashes per item per wave
operational_validation.change_classification: S203 change classification — 4 change types (NEW, MODIFIED, UNCHANGED, ROTATED)
operational_validation.review_savings: S809 case study: 60→10 agent reduction potential via delta-only review

P3_delta_review.violation_detection: Any session that re-reviews items whose SHA-256 hash matches the prior wave baseline. Detected via: delta ledger comparison — (items_reviewed / items_changed) > 1.5 indicates delta review not applied.
P3_delta_review.enforcement: S202 Delta Review Engineering specification — all certification waves must include delta determination step before agent dispatch

P4_readiness_before_certification.title: Readiness Before Certification
P4_readiness_before_certification.statement: No item shall enter the Certified state without passing all pre-flight structural gates. The pre-flight pipeline (Gates 0-4, ~8 minutes) must complete with zero blocking errors before any Quality Board review begins. Structural cleanliness is a prerequisite for content quality review.

historical_evidence.readiness_failure_rate: 89.5% prior to Framework v2 — 34 of 38 Domain E seeds arrived at certification with 2+ concurrent defects.
historical_evidence.DL-008_539_occurrences: 539 ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] non-empty occurrences shipped to Certified pool before governance guard Rule 2 was activated.
historical_evidence.DL-026_1005_items: 1,005 items with empty distractor slots entered certification pipeline without detection.
historical_evidence.DL-021_100_items: 100 Pack E Section C items with zero distractor explanations certified.
historical_evidence.DL-030_5_errors: 5 answer-key errors certified into learner pool.
historical_evidence.DL-035_39_items: 39 Domain F items certified post-Framework v2 through a gate that checked DL-008 but not DL-026 — a governance coverage gap, not a framework gap.

operational_validation.pre_flight_gate_model: S201 Board 7 — 10 automated scans across 5 gates, ~8 minute pipeline
operational_validation.readiness_reduction: 89.5% → <12% readiness failure rate after Framework v2 deployment
operational_validation.governance_guard_rules: Rule 2 (DL-008 BLOCK), Rule 6 (DL-026 BLOCK) — automated enforcement at write-time
operational_validation.certification_velocity: 304.5 items/day over 4 days, 30 cert events — faster AND safer

P4_readiness_before_certification.violation_detection: Any item with question_state='Certified' that does not have a corresponding readiness gate PASS record. Detected via: certification audit (question_state count with gate records < total certified count).
P4_readiness_before_certification.enforcement: Pre-flight gate pipeline (Gates 0-4) — blocking. Governance guard Rules 2+6 — blocking at write-time.

P5_governance_automation.title: Governance Automation
P5_governance_automation.statement: Content governance rules shall be enforced at the tool-execution level by automated guards, not by human discipline. Every defect class that has a known detection pattern shall have a corresponding BLOCK-level governance guard rule. WARN-level rules notify but do not prevent certification.

historical_evidence.pre_guard_certification: Items were certified into learner pool with DL-008, DL-026, DL-021, DL-030 because no automated guard blocked them.
historical_evidence.rule2_activation: Rule 2 (DL-008 BLOCK) activated 2026-07-22 — 539 occurrences already in pool. Post-activation: 0 new DL-008 introduced.
historical_evidence.rule6_gap: 39 Domain F items certified S853 because Rule 6 (DL-026 BLOCK) was not yet deployed. Deployed S814 — 0 new DL-026-on-Certified since.
historical_evidence.rule5_batch_cap: Rule 5 (30-item cap) prevents large-scale undetected defects — enforced on every write.

operational_validation.active_rules: 6 rules (Rules 1-6): 5 BLOCK, 1 WARN (Rule 1 question_state→REVISION_HISTORY). 32/32 test suite PASS.
operational_validation.rule_coverage: DL-008 (Rule 2), DL-026 (Rule 6), Registry protection (Rule 3), Batch cap (Rule 5), REVISION_HISTORY pairing (Rule 1 WARN), Answer-key verification (Rule 4 WARN)
operational_validation.defect_prevention: 0 new DL-008, 0 new DL-026-on-Certified since respective rules deployed

P5_governance_automation.violation_detection: Any new defect class discovered without a corresponding governance guard rule within one session of discovery. Detected via: DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entry with Status='Open' and no matching governance guard rule.
P5_governance_automation.enforcement: governance-guard.js — all rules active. New defect classes must produce new rules.

P6_traceability_everywhere.title: Traceability Everywhere
P6_traceability_everywhere.statement: Every entity in the system — questions, sessions, recommendations, challenges, investigations, certification events — shall be traceable through registries. No entity shall exist without a registry entry. Every state transition, certification decision, and remediation action shall be recorded in REVISION_HISTORY.md with before/after evidence.

historical_evidence.P1-EC-004_inconsistency: Registry reported 'Unprocessed' but REVISION_HISTORY said 'Certified' in S853 — a traceability gap flagged and tracked (S254).
historical_evidence.session_to_qid_traceability: S254: 40 sessions, 535 unique QIDs linked, 0 duplicate/phantom/orphan references — traceability working.
historical_evidence.MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY: Auto-generated from raw pack files — never hand-edited (governance guard Rule 3). Single source of truth for question inventory.

operational_validation.registries: 7 registries validated (S254): question, session, recommendation, challenge, investigation, certification, defect
operational_validation.revision_history: REVISION_HISTORY.md pairs with every question_state change and certification event (Rule 1 WARN enforcement)

P6_traceability_everywhere.violation_detection: Any entity referenced in one registry but absent from another when both should reflect the same entity. Detected via: cross-engine consistency scan (S254 pattern). Registry-vs-raw-file question_state mismatch.
P6_traceability_everywhere.enforcement: Governance guard Rule 3 (MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY auto-generation), Rule 1 (REVISION_HISTORY pairing WARN)
